name: Hell Knight
description:
Careful planning and uptight caution are nothing but a cause to doubt oneself. Hell Knights realize this fact, and instead opt to send their creatures charging headlong into battle, relying on brute strength and reckless attacks to ensure a swift victory.
As a Hell Knight, you'll favor creatures that specialize in attacking. Hell Knights grant their creatures increased critical damage and cause a variety of effects to occur when they attack. Hell Knights are surprisingly adept at spellcasting in a pinch, as well.

perks.name: Blazing Soul
perks.description: When your creatures afflict enemies with Burning, their Attack is used to determine the potency of this debuff if it is higher than their Intelligence.
perks.description_cn: 当你的生物对敌方施加燃烧时，如果它们的攻击高于智力，则会使用攻击来决定此减益的效能。
perks.description_display: 当你的生物对敌方施加燃烧时，如果它们的攻击高于智力，则会使用攻击来决定此减益的效能。

perks.name: Bolster
perks.description: Your creatures take 1% less damage from attacks and spells for every 1% of Health they're missing.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每损失1%的生命值，就会减少1%来自攻击和法术的伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每损失1%的生命值，就会减少1%来自攻击和法术的伤害。

perks.name: Deadly Calm

perks.description_display: 敌方无法挑衅。

perks.name: Death Sentence

perks.description_cn: 你的生物的暴击攻击造成的伤害提高60%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的暴击攻击造成的伤害提高60%。

perks.name: Dreadnaught

perks.description_display: 你的生物的攻击无法被闪避。

perks.description_cn: 你的生物额外攻击1次。
perks.description_display: 你的生物额外攻击1次。

perks.name: Executioner

perks.description_display: 你的生物攻击造成的伤害提高50%。

perks.name: Indomitable

perks.description_cn: 你的生物免疫受辱。
perks.description_display: 你的生物免疫受辱。

perks.name: Inner Focus
perks.description: When your creatures cast a spell, 1% of their Attack per rank is added to their Intelligence to determine the amount of damage dealt. Maximum Bonus: 25% of attack stat contributed
perks.description_cn: 当你的生物施放法术时，25%的攻击会被添加到智力中来确定造成的伤害量。

perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你队伍中的第一个生物施放火焰风暴。

perks.name: Magma Diver
perks.description: Your creatures always have Splashing and Savage.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物始终带有飞溅和野蛮。
perks.description_display: 你的生物始终带有飞溅和野蛮。

perks.name: Massacre

perks.description_cn: 你的生物的飞溅增益现在对所有敌方造成伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的飞溅增益现在对所有敌方造成伤害。

perks.name: Pyromania

perks.description_cn: 在你的生物攻击后，它们有20%几率施放火焰风暴。

name: Reaver
description:
Perseverance, an iron will, and a touch of insanity are the perfect recipe for victory. Reavers live and die by this mantra, instilling their creatures with a cold and calculated anger that allows them to grow more powerful during battle while their foes tire out.
As a Reaver, your creatures will gain massive benefits in combat as battle continue to drag on. If your creatures manage to survive for just a few extra turns, they'll be able to devastate your enemies.

perks.name: Blitzkrieg
perks.description: Your creatures' attacks that happen simultaneously to the same target deal 1% more damage per rank than the last. Maximum Bonus: 50% more damage
perks.description_cn: 你的生物对同一目标同时发动多次攻击时，每次攻击比上一次多造成50%的伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物对同一目标同时发动多次攻击时，每次攻击比上一次多造成50%的伤害。

perks.name: Controlled Anger
perks.description: After your creatures take 2 turns, they become immune to debuffs for the rest of the battle.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物经历2回合后，它们在战斗剩余时间内将免疫减益。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物经历2回合后，它们在战斗剩余时间内将免疫减益。

perks.name: Mental Clarity
perks.description: After your creatures take 2 turns, they can Cast spells without consuming any Charges for the rest of the battle.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物经历3回合后，它们可以在战斗剩余时间内施放法术而不消耗任何充能。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物经历3回合后，它们可以在战斗剩余时间内施放法术而不消耗任何充能。

perks.name: Mercurial
perks.description: After your creatures are Attacked, and they fail to dodge the attack, their chance to dodge attacks is doubled the next time they're Attacked. This effect stacks multiple times in a row until they successfully dodge an attack.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物被攻击后，如果它们未能闪避攻击，下次被攻击时它们的闪避几率将翻倍。这个效果可以连续叠加多次，直到它们成功闪避一次攻击为止。

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.description: Your creatures deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage for each battle you've won in the current realm. If you're not in a realm, this perk acts as if you've won 8 battles.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每在当前领域赢得一场战斗，就会造成5%更多伤害并承受5%更少伤害。如果你不在领域中，此专长会视为你已赢得8场战斗。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每在当前领域赢得一场战斗，就会造成5%更多伤害并承受5%更少伤害。如果你不在领域中，此专长会视为你已赢得8场战斗。

perks.name: Proliferation
perks.description: Your creatures deal 30% more damage for each turn they've taken in battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物在战斗中每行动一回合，造成的伤害增加30%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物在战斗中每行动一回合，造成的伤害增加30%。

perks.name: Rapid Exhaustion
perks.description: Battle fatigue accumulates 2% faster per rank. Maximum Bonus: 50% quicker fatigue rate
perks.description_cn: 战斗疲劳累积速度提高50%。
perks.description_display: 战斗疲劳累积速度提高50%。

perks.name: Red-eye Flight

perks.name: Reign of Chaos

perks.description_cn: 你的生物在当前领域中每赢得一场战斗，攻击、智力、防御和速度就会增加15%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物在当前领域中每赢得一场战斗，攻击、智力、防御和速度就会增加15%。

perks.name: Relentless
perks.description: After your creatures Attack, and the attack fails to deal critical damage, their chance to deal critical damage with attacks is doubled on their next turn. This effect stacks multiple times in a row until the creature deals critical damage with attacks.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物攻击后，如果攻击未能造成暴击伤害，它们在下一回合的攻击暴击几率将翻倍。此效果可以连续叠加多次，直到该生物的攻击造成暴击伤害为止。

perks.name: Skirmish
perks.description: Your creatures have a 1% chance per rank to Attack an additional time. This effect can occur repeatedly until it fails. Maximum Bonus: 25% chance
perks.description_cn: 你的生物有25%几率额外攻击一次。此效果可以重复触发，直到失败为止。
perks.description_display: 你的生物有25%几率额外攻击一次。此效果可以重复触发，直到失败为止。

perks.name: Stimulation

perks.description_cn: 你的生物不再受到战斗疲劳的额外伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物不再受到战斗疲劳的额外伤害。

perks.description_cn: 如果你的生物已经经历了至少2回合，它们在其回合开始时会攻击一个随机敌方。

name: Pyromancer
description:
Pyromancers quite literally thrive on watching the world burn. These maniacal magi ignite both friend and foe alike with a brilliant conflagration, causing their enemies to suffer gruesome deaths while empowering their allies with the power of flame.
As a Pyromancer, you'll make heavy use of the Burning debuff to deal damage to enemies over time. In addition, your own creatures will be afflicted with this debuff, but it will heal and empower them rather than dealing damage.

perks.description: After an enemy takes damage from Burning, they are afflicted with either Scorned or Silenced.
perks.description_cn: 敌方受到燃烧伤害后，会被施加受辱或沉默。

perks.name: Burn Out

perks.description_display: 你的生物造成的伤害额外增加等同于其燃烧减益效能的20%。

perks.name: Burn Their Corpses

perks.name: Combustion

perks.description_cn: 敌方受到燃烧伤害后，有20%几率被送至时间线底部。

perks.name: Conflagration

perks.description_cn: 在你的生物受到燃烧伤害或治疗后，所有生物的燃烧减益的效能增加50%。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物受到燃烧伤害或治疗后，所有生物的燃烧减益的效能增加50%。

perks.name: Immolation
perks.description: Your creatures' spells that interact with Burning have 5% more potency per rank. Maximum Bonus: 100% more potency
perks.description_cn: 你的生物与燃烧有关的法术效能提高100%。

perks.name: Pyroblast

perks.description_cn: 敌方受到燃烧伤害后，你的每个生物都有20%几率对一名敌方施放一个灾祸法术。灾祸法术的职业类型取决于敌方的职业。

perks.name: Roaring Blaze

perks.description_cn: 当一个带有燃烧的敌方被击杀后，敌方将受到等同于该生物燃烧减益效能100%的伤害。

description:
Necromancers prefer to overwhelm their foes by summoning minions to aid their creatures in battle. Enemies are often so perplexed by the number of undead monstrosities charging at them from across the battlefield that they're dead long before they realize what even happened.
As a Necromancer, you'll summon minions to aid your creatures in battle. These minions can do all kinds of things to support your creatures - they can cause damage, boost your creatures' stats, debuff enemies, and much more.

perks.description: Your creatures start battles with 1 Zombie per rank. Maximum Bonus: 3 Zombies
perks.description_cn: 你的生物开始战斗时获得3个僵尸。

perks.description_display: 在你的生物施放一个法术后，它们召唤征服。

perks.description_cn: 你的生物开始战斗时获得3个扭曲者。
perks.description_display: 你的生物开始战斗时获得3个扭曲者。

perks.description_cn: 你的生物开始战斗时获得3个不稳定恐魔。

description_display:
Necromancers prefer to overwhelm their foes by summoning minions to aid their creatures in battle. Enemies are often so perplexed by the number of undead monstrosities charging at them from across the battlefield that they're dead long before they realize what even happened.

description_display:
The Blood Mage is a deranged spellcaster who is willing to do anything to overcome his foes - even at the cost of his own creatures' lives. This menacing spellcaster is adept at manipulating the lifeforce of allies and foes alike in his endless pursuit for power.
As a Blood Mage, your creatures will grow more powerful as they take damage. To facilitate these effects, the Blood Mage offers a variety of different ways to inflict damage on his own creatures.

name: Cleric
description:
The best offense, as some say, is a good defense. Clerics protect their creatures with powerful healing abilities and steadfast barriers, ensuring that not even the most tenacious of foes can overcome them.
As a Cleric, you'll specialize in healing abilities, as well as buffing, resurrection, stat-boosting effects, and providing your creatures with protective barriers. Your creatures will be extremely difficult to kill.

Burn the witch, judge the heretic, and slay the non-believer. Inquisitors make use of healing effects just as much for offense as they do for defense. They enact justice on behalf of the gods, and no one will be spared from holy rapture.
As an Inquisitor, you'll have a solution at your disposal for every problem you encounter. In addition, Inquisitors are able ot use healing effects for offensive purposes - for example, when your creatures heal enemies, they instead cause damage to them.

description:
A strong defense is unnecessary when your foe is unable to strike you in the first place. Monks grant their creatures unmatched agility, enabling them to dodge incoming attacks and spells, and respond with devastating counter-attacks.
As a Monk, you'll boost your creatures' chance to Dodge attacks and spells. When your creatures Dodge, they'll unleash a devastating counter-attack on the enemy.

name: Druid
description:
Many people foolishly mistake a Druid's introversion for weakness. These magi believe that quality always trumps quantity on the battlefield. Contrary to tradition, they are often seen with fewer than six creatures at their disposal, but the havoc their limited numbers wreak when augmented by Druidic magic is a sight to behold.
As a Druid, you'll probably only want to have one (or up to three, later on) creatures in your party. Your creatures will gain massive benefits for being part of a smaller party.
This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

description_display:
Many people foolishly mistake a Druid's introversion for weakness. These magi believe that quality always trumps quantity on the battlefield. Contrary to tradition, they are often seen with fewer than six creatures at their disposal, but the havoc their limited numbers wreak when augmented by Druidic magic is a sight to behold.
As a Druid, you'll probably only want to have one (or up to three, later on) creatures in your party. Your creatures will gain massive benefits for being part of a smaller party.
This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

name: Tribalist
description:
Strength in numbers. Tribalists prefer to use creatures that belong to the same race or class, and take full advantage of the synergy and camaraderie they offer each other.

This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

description:
Luck is not merely a matter of chance, but instead a force that can be manipulated to a clever man's will. Tricksters capitalize on this fact, enabling their creatures to re-roll the proverbial dice whenever fate doesn't turn out quite they way they hoped.

The Doombringer draws magic from the Bastion of the Void to fuel his creatures with vast amounts of power. Doombringers specialize in allowing their creatures to perform actions multiple times in a row, all while nullifying his enemies' efforts.

description_display:

name: Fanatic
description:
Fanatics devote their lives to serving the gods. From dusk until dawn, these magi toil away at a neverending list of demands to better-serve each of the 21 gods of Rodia. Such devotion is not without purpose, however, for the Fanatic is able to call on the gods' power to serve him in his time of need.
As a Fanatic, you'll be able to take additional Avatar creatures with you on your journey and empower them and their Ultimate Spell Gems with potent magic. Fanatics also make use of Godspawn creatures and create powerful synergies between them and their Avatar allies.
NOTE: Fanatic is special even among non-starter specializations, as it requires you to obtain an Avatar creature and bring it to Everett when attempting to start the project to unlock it.

description_display:
Fanatics devote their lives to serving the gods. From dusk until dawn, these magi toil away at a neverending list of demands to better-serve each of the 21 gods of Rodia. Toxicologists spend their days tarrying away at all manner of potions and elixirs that might serve their use in battle. perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，敌方会被施加炸弹。

perks.name: Prototype
perks.description: The potency of enemies' Bomb debuffs that are applied after start-of-battle effects is based on your creatures' highest stats (other than Health) instead of Speed.
perks.description_cn: 敌方在战斗开始效果后施加的炸弹减益的强度基于你生物的最高属性值（除了生命值）而不是速度。
perks.description_display: 敌方在战斗开始效果后施加的炸弹减益的强度基于你生物的最高属性值（除了生命值）而不是速度。

perks.name: Renewable Armaments
perks.description: After an enemy's Bomb detonates, it has a 35% chance to be afflicted with Bomb again.
perks.description_cn: 敌方的炸弹引爆后，有35%几率再次被施加炸弹。
perks.description_display: 敌方的炸弹引爆后，有35%几率再次被施加炸弹。

perks.name: Chain Reaction (ASCENSION)
perks.description: After an enemy takes damage from Bomb, all other enemies take this damage as well.
perks.description_cn: 敌方受到炸弹伤害后，所有其他敌方也会受到相同伤害。
perks.description_display: 敌方受到炸弹伤害后，所有其他敌方也会受到相同伤害。

description_display:
The Engineer's sole purpose in life is to build a bigger and better explosive than last time. This bombastic bombardier belays bombs to its opponent's backs, blasting them back to the bilgewater from whence they were born.
As an Engineer, you'll strap bombs to enemies and blow them to bits. The Engineer is also accompanied by their greatest invention: the Microbot minion!
This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

name: Brewmaster
description:
The Brewmaster believes that no problem can't be solved with a full mug of beer... or six. This unexpected hero generously distributes all manner of ales and cocktails to friend and foe alike - but all should be wary when the time comes to pay the bill.
As a Brewmaster, you'll rely on Booze spells to... well... make everyone get really, really drunk.

perks.name: Autograt
perks.description: After start-of-battle effects are determined, your creatures' Booze spells gain the â€˜Chance to Attack', â€˜Chance to Defend', and â€˜Chance to Provoke' properties.
perks.description_cn: 在确定战斗开始效果后，你的生物的[临时]虚幻酒精法术获得"概率在施法后攻击"、"概率在施法后防御"和"概率在施法后挑衅"词条。
perks.description_display: 在确定战斗开始效果后，你的生物的[临时]虚幻酒精法术获得"概率在施法后攻击"、"概率在施法后防御"和"概率在施法后挑衅"词条。

perks.name: Brewmaster's Handshake
perks.description: Your creatures can cast Booze spells manually.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物可以手动施放酒精法术。
perks.description_display: 你的生物可以手动施放酒精法术。

perks.name: Chaser
perks.description: After your creatures manually cast a Booze spell, they have a 50% chance to Cast a random spell. Otherwise, they Attack a random enemy.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物手动施放一个酒精法术后，它们有50%的几率施放一个随机法术。否则，它们攻击一个随机敌方。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物手动施放一个酒精法术后，它们有50%的几率施放一个随机法术。否则，它们攻击一个随机敌方。

perks.name: Double Entendre
perks.description: Your creatures' Booze spells also have a chance to be Cast at the start of the equipped creatures' turns.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的酒精法术也有机会在装备它的生物回合开始时被施放。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的酒精法术也有机会在装备它的生物回合开始时被施放。

perks.name: Experimental Cocktail
perks.description: At the start of battle, your creatures gain all Booze spells that belong to their class.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的生物获得所有属于其职业的酒精法术。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的生物获得所有属于其职业的酒精法术。

perks.name: Highball
perks.description: Your creatures' Booze spells count 50% less against their per-turn Casting limit.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的酒精法术计入每回合施法上限时减少50%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的酒精法术计入每回合施法上限时减少50%。

perks.name: Inebriation
perks.description: Enemies have a 5% chance (up to 80%) to deal no damage for each time they've been affected by an Booze spell in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 敌方每次在当前战斗中受到酒精法术影响，就有5%的几率（最高80%）造成零伤害。
perks.description_display: 敌方每次在当前战斗中受到酒精法术影响，就有5%的几率（最高80%）造成零伤害。

perks.name: Liquid Courage
perks.description: Your creatures deal 3% more damage for each time they've cast a Booze spell in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物在当前战斗中每施放过一次酒精法术，就会造成3%额外伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物在当前战斗中每施放过一次酒精法术，就会造成3%额外伤害。

perks.name: Muddle
perks.description: Your creatures attack 1 additional time (up to 3) for every 5 Booze spells they've Cast in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每在当前战斗中施放了5个酒精法术，就会额外攻击1次（最多3次）。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每在当前战斗中施放了5个酒精法术，就会额外攻击1次（最多3次）。

perks.name: Nightcap
perks.description: Enemies cannot be resurrected if they have been affected by Booze spells at least 3 times in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 敌方如果在当前战斗中至少受到3次酒精法术的影响，则无法被复活。
perks.description_display: 敌方如果在当前战斗中至少受到3次酒精法术的影响，则无法被复活。

perks.name: Numb the Pain
perks.description: Your creatures have a 5% chance (up to 80%) to avoid damage for each time they've been affected by an Booze spell in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每次在当前战斗中受到酒精法术影响，就有5%的几率（最高80%）避免伤害。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每次在当前战斗中受到酒精法术影响，就有5%的几率（最高80%）避免伤害。

perks.name: On The House
perks.description: Your creatures' Booze spells do not consume Charges.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的酒精法术不消耗充能。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的酒精法术不消耗充能。

perks.name: Speed Rail
perks.description: Your creatures cast Booze spells 1 additional time (up to 3) for every 5 Booze spells they've cast in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每在当前战斗中施放了5个酒精法术，就可以额外施放1次（最多3次）。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每在当前战斗中施放了5个酒精法术，就可以额外施放1次（最多3次）。

perks.name: Straight Up
perks.description: Your creatures' Booze spells cannot be Sealed.
perks.description_cn: 生物的酒精法术无法被封印。
perks.description_display: 生物的酒精法术无法被封印。

perks.name: Top Shelf
perks.description: Your creatures' Booze spells have a 100% increased chance to be cast.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的酒精法术有100%更多的几率被施放。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的酒精法术有100%更多的几率被施放。

perks.name: Drunken Camaraderie (ASCENSION)
perks.description: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage and your creatures are healed for a moderate amount when they are affected by your creatures' Booze spells.
perks.description_cn: 当被你生物的酒精法术影响时，敌方受到中等伤害，盟友会恢复中等数量的生命值。
perks.description_display: 当被你生物的酒精法术影响时，敌方受到中等伤害，盟友会恢复中等数量的生命值。

name: Demonologist
description:
The Demonologist is a wicked summoner who conjures terrible demons from the depths of hell to aid his creatures in battle. This chaotic sorcerer uses Greater Demons to do his bidding while sacrificing Lesser Demons to empower his own creatures.
As a Demonologist, you'll summon powerful demons from the depths of hell to do your bidding.
This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

perks.name: Brim Fiends
perks.description: At the start of your creatures' turns, they gain 1 stack of Brim Fiends.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层边缘魔物。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层边缘魔物。

perks.name: Chaos Satyrs
perks.description: At the start of your creatures' turns, they gain 1 stack of Chaos Satyr.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层混沌萨堤尔。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层混沌萨堤尔。

perks.name: Demonic Consumption
perks.description: After any number of stacks of your creatures' Lesser or Greater Demons go away, they recover 100% Health.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的任意层数的次级恶魔或高级恶魔消失后，它们恢复100%生命值。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的任意层数的次级恶魔或高级恶魔消失后，它们恢复100%生命值。

perks.name: Demonic Pact
perks.description: Your creatures have 10% more stats (excluding Health) for each different Greater Demon your creatures have.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物每拥有一种不同的大恶魔，其属性值（不包括生命值）就会提高10%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物每拥有一种不同的大恶魔，其属性值（不包括生命值）就会提高10%。

perks.name: Drained Essence
perks.description: Your creatures deal 3% more damage for each time all your creatures' minions went away in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 在当前战斗中，每当你所有生物的仆从全部消失一次，你的生物就会多造成3%的伤害。
perks.description_display: 在当前战斗中，每当你所有生物的仆从全部消失一次，你的生物就会多造成3%的伤害。

perks.name: Final Summoning
perks.description: After your creatures' Greater Demons go away, they cast a powerful spell depending on which Greater Demon went away.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物的大恶魔消失后，它们会施放一个强力法术，具体取决于哪个大恶魔消失了。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物的大恶魔消失后，它们会施放一个强力法术，具体取决于哪个大恶魔消失了。

perks.name: Fire Imps
perks.description: At the start of your creatures' turns, they gain 1 stack of Fire Imps.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层火焰小鬼。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物回合开始时，它们获得1层火焰小鬼。

perks.name: Inner Demons
perks.description: After any number of stacks of your creatures' Lesser Demons go away, they gain 15% stats.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物的任意数量的次级恶魔层数消失后，它们获得15%属性值加成。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物的任意数量的次级恶魔层数消失后，它们获得15%属性值加成。

perks.name: Reawakening
perks.description: After your creatures sacrifice a Lesser Demon, each stack has a 35% chance to resurrect.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物牺牲一个次级恶魔后，每层有35%的几率复活。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物牺牲一个次级恶魔后，每层有35%的几率复活。

perks.name: Renounce the Light
perks.description: Your creatures cannot gain buffs or minions that are unrelated to this specialization. This perk is always active while your specialization is Demonologist, even if you haven't allocated any Perk Points to it.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物无法获得与此专精无关的增益或仆从。你的大恶魔在死亡时不会被移除。此专长在你的专精为恶魔学家时始终处于激活状态，即使你未为其分配任何专长点。
perks.description_display: 你的生物无法获得与此专精无关的增益或仆从。你的大恶魔在死亡时不会被移除。此专长在你的专精为恶魔学家时始终处于激活状态，即使你未为其分配任何专长点。

perks.name: Soul Shield
perks.description: Your creatures take 3% less damage (up to 80%) for each time all your creatures' minions went away in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 在当前战斗中，每当你所有生物的仆从全部消失一次，你的生物受到的伤害就减少3%。
perks.description_display: 在当前战斗中，每当你所有生物的仆从全部消失一次，你的生物受到的伤害就减少3%。

perks.name: Summon Asmodeus
perks.description: At the start of battle, your Chaos creatures gain Asmodeus.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的混沌生物获得阿斯蒙蒂斯。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的混沌生物获得阿斯蒙蒂斯。

perks.name: Summon Beelzebub
perks.description: At the start of battle, your Death creatures gain Beelzebub.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的死亡生物获得别西卜。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的死亡生物获得别西卜。

perks.name: Summon Belphegor
perks.description: At the start of battle, your Sorcery creatures gain Belphegor.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的巫术生物获得贝尔芬格。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的巫术生物获得贝尔芬格。

perks.name: Summon Leviathan
perks.description: At the start of battle, your Nature creatures gain Leviathan.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的自然生物获得利维坦。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的自然生物获得利维坦。

perks.name: Summon Mammon
perks.description: At the start of battle, your Life creatures gain Mammon.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，你的生命生物获得玛门。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，你的生命生物获得玛门。

perks.name: Summon Satanachia
perks.description: At the start of battle, if your creatures collectively have Asmodeus, Beelzebub, Mammon, Leviathan, and Belphegor, they gain Satanachia.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，如果你的生物集体拥有阿斯蒙蒂斯、别西卜、玛门、利维坦和贝尔芬格，它们将获得萨塔尼基亚。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，如果你的生物集体拥有阿斯蒙蒂斯、别西卜、玛门、利维坦和贝尔芬格，它们将获得萨塔尼基亚。

perks.name: Void Shift
perks.description: When your creatures' Greater Demons would go away, they move to a different creature fighting on your side instead.
perks.description_cn: 当你的生物的强大恶魔即将消失时，它们会转移到你方战斗中的另一个生物身上。
perks.description_display: 当你的生物的强大恶魔即将消失时，它们会转移到你方战斗中的另一个生物身上。

perks.name: Summon Lucifer (ASCENSION)
perks.description: At the start of battle, if your creatures collectively have Asmodeus, Beelzebub, Mammon, Leviathan, and Belphegor, your creatures gain Lucifer.
perks.description_cn: 战斗开始时，如果你的生物集体拥有阿斯蒙蒂斯、别西卜、玛门、利维坦和贝尔芬格，你的生物将获得路西法。
perks.description_display: 战斗开始时，如果你的生物集体拥有阿斯蒙蒂斯、别西卜、玛门、利维坦和贝尔芬格，你的生物将获得路西法。

name: Gladiator
description:
The Gladiator is a master of the arena, sporting tremendous proficiency with all manner of weapons. No sword, no axe, no bow is too difficult for this master of armaments to wield.
As a Gladiator, you'll utilize powerful Arsenal spells to bolster your forces and devastate your opponents. In addition, your creatues' Artifacts will become far stronger than normal.
This is an Advanced specialization and as such cannot be chosen at the beginning, nor does it get a starter creature.

perks.name: Acclimated Armaments
perks.description: Your creatures' Arsenal spells are 5% more potent for each time they've Cast an Arsenal spell in the current battle.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的军械法术效能在当前战斗中每施放一次军械法术就会提高5%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的军械法术效能在当前战斗中每施放一次军械法术就会提高5%。

perks.name: Blacksmith's Boon
perks.description: Your creatures' Trick Slots that apply buffs and debuffs have a 35% greater chance to activate.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的技巧槽位所施加的增益和减益效果有35%额外的触发几率。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的技巧槽位所施加的增益和减益效果有35%额外的触发几率。

perks.name: Crowd Favorite
perks.description: After your creatures' Trick Slots activate, they gain a random Arsenal Spell.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物的技巧槽激活后，它们获得一个随机军械法术。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物的技巧槽激活后，它们获得一个随机军械法术。

perks.name: Double Time
perks.description: Your creatures' Trick Slots that apply buffs and debuffs affect 1 additional creature.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的技巧槽所施加的增益和减益会影响额外1个生物。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的技巧槽所施加的增益和减益会影响额外1个生物。

perks.name: Elbow Grease
perks.description: Your creatures gain 50% more benefit from their Artifact's Stat Slots.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物从其神器的属性值槽中获得的加成提高50%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物从其神器的属性值槽中获得的加成提高50%。

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Your creatures deal 15% more damage with attacks and spells for each debuff they afflicted from all your Artifacts' Trick Slots.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物对于每个来自你所有神器的技巧槽所施加的减益，其攻击和法术造成的伤害提高15%。
perks.description_display: 你的生物对于每个来自你所有神器的技巧槽所施加的减益，其攻击和法术造成的伤害提高15%。

perks.name: Grip of the Gods
perks.description: Your creatures are immune to Disarmed.
perks.name_display: 众神之握 (Grip of the Gods)
perks.description_cn: 你的生物免疫缴械。
perks.description_display: 你的生物免疫缴械。

perks.name: Helping Hand
perks.description: After your creatures' Trick Slots activate, they resurrect an ally with 50% Health. If none of your creatures are dead, they heal an ally for 50% Health instead.
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物的技巧槽激活后，它们会复活一个友方，恢复50%生命值。如果你的生物都没有死亡，它们会改为治疗一个友方50%生命值。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物的技巧槽激活后，它们会复活一个友方，恢复50%生命值。如果你的生物都没有死亡，它们会改为治疗一个友方50%生命值。

perks.name: Impending Victory
perks.description: 50% of the potency of your creatures' Arsenal Spells is based on their highest stat instead of Intelligence.
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的军械法术效能的50%基于它们最高的属性值，而非智力。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的军械法术效能的50%基于它们最高的属性值，而非智力。

perks.name: It's Called a Lance
perks.description: After your creatures manually Cast an Arsenal Spell, they cast a Living Lance spell. The type of Living Lance spell is based on the caster's class.
perks.name_display: 此乃长枪 (It's Called a Lance)
perks.description_cn: 在你的生物手动施放一个军械法术后，它们施放一个活体长矛法术。活体长矛法术的类型取决于施法者的职业。
perks.description_display: 在你的生物手动施放一个军械法术后，它们施放一个活体长矛法术。活体长矛法术的类型取决于施法者的职业。

perks.name: Nether Imbuement
perks.description: Your creatures' Nether Stones are 5% more powerful per rank. This perk does not affect a Nether Stone's traits, spells, or any Trick Slots that increase a creature's maximum number of Spell Gem slots. Maximum Bonus: 50% more powerful
perks.description_cn: 你的生物的下界石威力提升50%。此专长不影响下界石的特性、法术或任何增加生物法术宝石槽位上限的技巧槽。
perks.description_display: 你的生物的下界石威力提升50%。此专长不影响下界石的特性、法术或任何增加生物法术宝石槽位上限的技巧槽。

perks.name: Reprimand
